units.source_text: 香剂制成后，盛瓷器内，埋在水边土中。

en.t: After the incense mixtures were prepared, they were placed in porcelain vessels and buried in the earth by the water.

units.source_text: “黑方”与“侍从”两种香剂，春秋埋五天，夏日埋三天，冬日埋七天。

en.t: The two incense mixtures, Black Formula and Chamberlain, were buried for five days in spring and autumn, three days in summer, and seven days in winter.
